description: One section of a TmDocumentDebugModal: a heading and a monospace block. A null, empty or whitespace Content hides the block and shows the localized "No data" notice instead; both test ids stay on the DOM so a host selector never goes stale.

parameters.name: SectionTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the section element (resolved through TestIdPrefix).

parameters.name: ContentTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the content block (resolved through TestIdPrefix).

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: Text shown in the monospace block. Null, empty or whitespace shows the localized "No data" notice instead.
